reporting-org.narrative: The Global Fund to Fight AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria

title.narrative: Middle East HIV, TB and Malaria response - Western Asia - Multicountry Middle East MER (01-Jan-2017-31-Dec-2018)

description.narrative: Multicountry Middle East MER, Multicomponent, International Organization for Migration (IOM)This program has the following goals: Provide essential HIV, TB, and malaria services to eligible country populations in Syria, Yemen and Syrian refugees in Jordan and Lebanon.. The objectives of this program are: JORDAN: Improving awareness and knowledge on TB among Syrian refugees. JORDAN: Improving TB, detection, diagnosis and treatment outcomes among Syrian refugees through the provision of equipment and supplies.. JORDAN: Providing treatment and care to Syrian refugees living with HIV. JORDAN: Supporting HIV testing and TB/HIV testing efforts among the Syrian refugee population. LEBANON: Ensuring TB diagnostics and treatment for Syrian refugees, including through provision of drugs and commodities.. LEBANON: Improving knowledge on the TB epidemic and improve coordination of the response to Syrian refugees.. LEBANON: Providing treatment and care to Syrian refugees living with HIV. LEBANON: Supporting HIV testing and TB/HIV testing efforts among the Syrian refugee population. SYRIA: Conducting testing and screening activities. SYRIA: Ensuring TB diagnostics and treatment, including through provision of drugs and commodities. SYRIA: Providing treatment and care to people living with HIV. YEMEN: Conducting HIV and TB testing and screening activities. YEMEN: Enhancing malaria prevention, including through the procurement of long lasting insecticide. YEMEN: Ensuring TB diagnostics and treatment, including through provision of drugs and commodities.. YEMEN: Providing treatment and care to people living with HIV, and people infected with TB and malaria
